subject: science
concept: Comparing materials by simple properties useful for building (hard/soft, flexible/rigid, waterproof/absorbent)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Engineering Design Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student tests several real or virtual materials for a chosen property (e.g. does it soak up water)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a material to the property it's best known for
exercise.abstract: Student predicts which material would work best for a described simple purpose

misconception_flags: picks a material based on appearance rather than its actual tested property

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
